mapper.sql: id, session_id, aid, question_round, step, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens, total_tokens, finished, status, debug, snapshot_json, create_time, modify_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_trace_snapshot (session_id, aid, question_round, step, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens, total_tokens, finished, status, debug, snapshot_json) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{aid}, #{questionRound}, #{step}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{durationMs}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{cachedTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{finished}, #{status}, #{debug}, #{snapshotJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_trace_snapshot SET aid=#{aid}, started_at=#{startedAt}, finished_at=#{finishedAt}, duration_ms=#{durationMs}, input_tokens=#{inputTokens}, output_tokens=#{outputTokens}, cached_tokens=#{cachedTokens}, total_tokens=#{totalTokens}, status=#{status}, debug=#{debug}, snapshot_json=#{snapshotJson}, modify_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND question_round=#{questionRound} AND step=#{step} AND finished=#{finished}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_agent_trace_snapshot WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND finished=1

SELECT t.id, t.session_id, t.aid, t.question_round, t.step, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.create_time, t.modify_time, t.status, t.debug, s.duration_ms, s.input_tokens, s.output_tokens, s.cached_tokens, s.total_tokens FROM ai_agent_trace_snapshot t JOIN ( SELECT session_id, SUM(duration_ms) duration_ms, SUM(input_tokens) input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) output_tokens, SUM(cached_tokens) cached_tokens, SUM(total_tokens) total_tokens, MAX(id) max_id FROM ai_agent_trace_snapshot WHERE finished = 1 AND aid = #{aid} AND debug = #{debug} GROUP BY session_id ) s ON s.max_id = t.id WHERE t.finished = 1 ORDER BY t.modify_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
